invariants: book.isbn must be unique across all books
author.id must be unique across all authors
member.email must be unique across all members
loan.book_id must reference a valid book (exists in books table)
loan.member_id must reference a valid member (exists in members table)
loan.return_date must be null if status is 'active'
loan.return_date must be set if status is 'returned'
loan.due_date must be a valid date (not in the past)
member.membership_date must be a valid date (not in the future)
